title: Aether — independent designer and developer portfolio
description: An editorial personal portfolio for a one-person studio. The hero is a magazine masthead and a contact sheet of every project in miniature, read through a draggable glass lens. Selected work glides between grid, row, feature and pile layouts, a pinned process story shows the palette deck, a peelable critique note and the tool dock, then writing, kind words, fixed-price services and a one-page signature to book.
sections: Masthead hero with glass lens contact sheet
features: Glass lens hero that magnifies a contact sheet of six projects
Project tiles that glide between four layouts and open from an index list
Pinned process story with a fan deck palette, a page curl review note and a magnifying dock
Fixed-price engagement picker that updates a sign-and-seal agreement card
Hydration-safe, reduced-motion aware, hard-coded light theme
